01 / THE WORKSPACE · ARCHITECTURAL MODEL


A workspace for local intelligence.

Nythos is an external, software-level workspace inspired by the global-workspace idea. It is not a model and does not read hidden activations or chain-of-thought.

MEMORY

Persistent state that can survive beyond a single interaction.

SALIENCE

Not everything matters equally.

WORKSPACE

A bounded active context.

CONTEXT

Only the information needed for the current task enters the working set.

POSTER 03

Memory is not the workspace.

03 / NYTHOS PLUS · EXPERIMENTAL SYSTEM


NYTHOS PLUS

Adaptive Effort for Local AI. Nythos gives local AI a workspace. Nythos Plus decides how much effort the task deserves.

E4 · large expanded computational state

Difficulty is not Effort Sensitivity.
More compute has a cost.
The goal is not maximum effort. The goal is sufficient effort.

POSTER 05

More compute is not always better.
